values.note: Reserve by phone (540-683-9673) with a 50% deposit; balance on arrival by cash or card (no checks). Drive-ups accepted April 1 to October 1 only. Refund less $10 with 7+ days' notice, deposit forfeited inside 7 days. Checkout noon Monday-Saturday, 4 p.m. Sunday.

values.note: Primitive campground: picnic table and fire ring at each site, portable toilets serviced weekly; generators permitted.

summary: Operator page confirms the phone booking with 50% deposit and the $40 site fee + $40/vehicle/night (fees left as checked 2026-10-15; the page carries no rate date beyond its 2026 footer). Season changed from derived Apr 1-Oct 1 to year-round: the operator says 'open year round' and Apr 1-Oct 1 is only the drive-up window. Hookups left as derived (page says primitive with generators permitted, nothing explicit on hookups).
